description.en: Sets up the attacker/defender character data for a skill/technique execution, given the attacker and defender counts, a shared data-set table, and the two characters involved.
Shared setup data for the technique.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Set up the attacker/defender data for a technique execution
CMND_SKILL_SETUP_CHARA(g_data.iAtkNum, g_data.iDefNum, data_set, g_data.chara_copy[0], g_data.chara_copy[1]);
